A cognitive robotic simulation approach.en: A cognitive robotic simulation approach evaluates attention models using iCub and human gaze datasets. It supports scalable, reproducible early-stage evaluation in physical environments, reducing the need for extensive human-participant studies at that stage.
A cognitive robotic simulation approach.zh: 一种认知机器人仿真方法使用iCub和人类注视数据集评估注意模型。该方法支持在物理环境中开展可扩展、可复现的早期评估，减少这一阶段对大规模人类参与者研究的需求。

Dr Di Fu visited the CONTACT Lab of Dr A.en: Dr Di Fu visited the CONTACT Lab of Dr Alessandra Sciutti and Dr Francesco Rea at the Italian Institute of Technology (IIT) on 18 June 2026. The visit provided an opportunity to exchange ideas and reconnect with colleagues.

Test models through robotic simulation a.zh: 通过机器人模拟以及人机或人与 AI 互动检验模型，并利用新证据完善模型和认知假设。

The first Interdisciplinary Conference o.en: The first Interdisciplinary Conference on Cognitive Science, Computational Modelling, and AI, organised and chaired by Di Fu at the University of Cambridge on 9-10 May 2025, brought together 120 attendees.
The first Interdisciplinary Conference o.zh: 首届认知科学、计算建模与 AI 跨学科会议于2025年5月9日至10日在剑桥大学举行，由 Di Fu 组织并主持，共有120人参加。

The page you are looking for does not ex.en: The page you are looking for does not exist. Please return to the home page or explore other sections of the site.
The page you are looking for does not ex.zh: 您要查找的页面不存在。请返回首页或浏览网站的其他版块。

Three mutually reinforcing research pill.en: Three mutually reinforcing research pillars form a closed loop.
Three mutually reinforcing research pill.zh: 三大相互促进的研究支柱构成一个闭环。

Translate human mechanisms and behaviour.en: Translate human mechanisms and behavioural evidence into computational models and learning systems for cognition-inspired AI.
Translate human mechanisms and behaviour.zh: 将人类机制和行为证据转化为计算模型与学习系统，推动认知启发的 AI。

Translate selected human mechanisms and.en: Human data constrain computational models, which turn cognitive accounts into testable predictions and robot behaviour.
Translate selected human mechanisms and.zh: 人类数据约束计算模型，把认知理论转化为可检验的预测和机器人行为。

Two experiments compared affective mirro.en: Two experiments compared affective mirroring by iCub and Pepper, and movement mirroring with different iCub control methods. iCub was perceived as more humanlike, while vision-based control produced better movement mirroring than IMU-based control.
Two experiments compared affective mirro.zh: 两项实验比较了 iCub 和 Pepper 的情感模仿，以及采用不同控制方法的 iCub 动作模仿。iCub 被认为更像人；与基于 IMU 的控制相比，基于视觉的控制带来了更好的动作模仿效果。

Two participants and iCub in a shared sh.en: Two participants and iCub in a cooperation experiment testing how robot social cues affect human-human coordination.
Two participants and iCub in a shared sh.zh: 两名参与者与 iCub 开展协作实验，检验机器人社会线索如何影响人与人的协调。

Two people and iCub around a tabletop sh.en: Two people and iCub around a tabletop shape-sorting task with an occluder and response buttons.
Two people and iCub around a tabletop sh.zh: 两人和 iCub 围坐在桌边进行图形分类任务，桌上设有遮挡板和响应按钮。

Unified Dynamic Scanpath Predictors.zh: 统一动态扫描路径预测器

Unitree Robot Dog, shown in a representa.en: Unitree Robot Dog, shown in a representative Go2 product image with all four legs visible
Unitree Robot Dog, shown in a representa.zh: Unitree 机器狗，代表性 Go2 产品图片，四条腿均清晰可见

Unitree's four-legged robots provide an.en: Unitree's four-legged robots provide an embodied platform for legged movement, navigation and interaction with the physical environment.
Unitree's four-legged robots provide an.zh: Unitree 的四足机器人为足式运动、导航及与物理环境互动提供具身平台。

Visit to the CONTACT Lab at IIT with iCu.en: Visit to the CONTACT Lab at IIT with iCub
Visit to the CONTACT Lab at IIT with iCu.zh: 与 iCub 一同访问 IIT 的 CONTACT 实验室

We investigate the neurocognitive mechan.en: We investigate the cognitive mechanisms underlying human social perception and multimodal cue integration, develop computational models of these mechanisms, and translate them into socially intelligent robots and conversational AI systems. Through human-AI interaction, we seek both to advance artificial social intelligence and to test and refine theories of human social cognition.
We investigate the neurocognitive mechan.zh: 我们研究人类社会知觉与多模态线索整合背后的认知机制，构建这些机制的计算模型，并将其转化为具有社会智能的机器人与对话式人工智能系统。通过人与人工智能的交互研究，我们既推动人工社会智能的发展，也检验并完善人类社会认知的理论。

What computational models can learn from.en: What computational models can learn from human selective attention
What computational models can learn from.zh: 计算模型能从人类选择性注意中学到什么

What makes a face, a gaze direction or a.en: What makes a face, a gaze direction or a face-like object capture and guide attention - and which mechanisms explain that effect?
What makes a face, a gaze direction or a.zh: 是什么使面孔、注视方向或类面孔物体捕获并引导注意？哪些机制可以解释这一效应？

What makes interaction with AI appropria.en: What makes interaction with AI appropriate to the person, emotional context and purpose?
What makes interaction with AI appropria.zh: 如何使人与人工智能的交互适合参与者、情绪情境和交互目的？

Workshop participants gathered at the se.en: Workshop participants at the second InterAI Workshop. The photograph shows the wider workshop community, not only SEIL Lab members.
Workshop participants gathered at the se.zh: 第二届 InterAI Workshop 的参与者合影。照片呈现的是更广泛的研讨会群体，并非只有 SEIL Lab 成员。

Wrapyfi and human-participant research a.en: Wrapyfi and human-participant research accepted at HRI 2024
Wrapyfi and human-participant research a.zh: Wrapyfi 与涉及人类参与者的研究获 HRI 2024 接收

Writing for Psychology Today on Humanoid.en: Writing for Psychology Today on Humanoid Robots and Everyday Life
Writing for Psychology Today on Humanoid.zh: 为《Psychology Today》撰写关于人形机器人与日常生活的文章

A call shared by co-organiser Doreen Jir.en: A call shared by co-organiser Doreen Jirak invited work on explainable AI, trust and human-centred interaction for the CO-HABIT Workshop at IEEE RO-MAN 2025. Archived call for papers.
A call shared by co-organiser Doreen Jir.zh: 联合组织者 Doreen Jirak 分享的征稿启事，邀请研究者为 IEEE RO-MAN 2025 的 CO-HABIT Workshop 投稿，主题包括可解释人工智能、信任和以人为中心的交互。此征稿启事已存档。

Abstract for the 2017 EUCog meeting; pos.en: Abstract for the 2017 EUCog meeting; posted to arXiv in 2018.
Abstract for the 2017 EUCog meeting; pos.zh: 2017 年 EUCog 会议摘要；2018 年发布于 arXiv。

As organising chair, Di Fu reflected on.en: As organising chair, Di Fu reflected on the inaugural Exploring Interdisciplinary Frontiers conference at Selwyn College, Cambridge, held on 9-10 May 2025 with over 120 participants from 18 countries.
As organising chair, Di Fu reflected on.zh: 作为组织主席，Di Fu 回顾了首届 Exploring Interdisciplinary Frontiers 会议。会议于 2025 年 5 月 9-10 日在剑桥大学塞尔文学院举行，吸引了来自 18 个国家的 120 多名参与者。

At ICRA in Atlanta, Di Fu presented HRI-.en: At ICRA in Atlanta, Di Fu presented HRI-Free, co-authored with Fares Abawi, and co-chaired the Perception for Human-Robot Interaction session. The study supports scalable, reproducible evaluation of embodied social attention.
At ICRA in Atlanta, Di Fu presented HRI-.zh: 在亚特兰大举行的 ICRA 上，Di Fu 介绍了与 Fares Abawi 合著的 HRI-Free，并共同主持了 Perception for Human-Robot Interaction 分会。该研究支持对具身社会注意进行可扩展、可复现的评估。

Chinese-language review. First released.en: Chinese-language review. First released online in 2022; assigned to the 2023 journal issue.
Chinese-language review. First released.zh: 中文综述。2022 年首次在线发表，编入 2023 年期刊卷期。

Conference poster listed in the CV; not.en: Conference poster listed in the CV; not counted as a published paper. Year refers to the event.
Conference poster listed in the CV; not.zh: 简历所列会议海报；不计作已发表论文。年份指会议举办年份。

Contribution to the IROS 2018 Crossmodal.en: Contribution to the IROS 2018 Crossmodal Learning workshop; available as an arXiv preprint.
Contribution to the IROS 2018 Crossmodal.zh: 对 IROS 2018 Crossmodal Learning workshop 的贡献；以 arXiv 预印本形式提供。

Contribution to the RO-MAN 2022 Machine.en: Contribution to the RO-MAN 2022 Machine Learning for HRI workshop; available as an arXiv preprint.
Contribution to the RO-MAN 2022 Machine.zh: 对 RO-MAN 2022 Machine Learning for HRI workshop 的贡献；以 arXiv 预印本形式提供。

Di Fu and fellow organisers brought toge.en: Di Fu and fellow organisers brought together the HRI community for the second InterAI Workshop, with discussions of embodiment, responsible robotics and flexible human-robot teaming.
Di Fu and fellow organisers brought toge.zh: Di Fu 与其他组织者共同举办第二届 InterAI Workshop，汇聚人机交互领域的研究者，讨论具身性、负责任的机器人技术及灵活的人机协作。

Di Fu announced her invitation to speak.en: Di Fu announced her invitation to speak at the IROS 2025 workshop on Embodied AI and Robotics for Future Scientific Discovery, scheduled for 24 October in Hangzhou.
Di Fu announced her invitation to speak.zh: Di Fu 宣布受邀在 IROS 2025 的 Embodied AI and Robotics for Future Scientific Discovery workshop 上演讲。该活动定于 10 月 24 日在杭州举行。

Di Fu congratulated her MSc dissertation.en: Di Fu congratulated her MSc dissertation student Beyza Akyıldız-Greenhalgh on receiving the Research Excellence Prize at Surrey’s MSc Psychology Summer Conference 2025.
Di Fu congratulated her MSc dissertation.zh: Di Fu 祝贺其硕士论文学生 Beyza Akyıldız-Greenhalgh 获得萨里大学 2025 年心理学硕士夏季会议的研究优秀奖。

Di Fu delivered a keynote at the SynSci.en: Di Fu delivered a keynote at the SynSci 2026 satellite session at the University of Glasgow, joining researchers to discuss connections between social cognitive science and AI.
Di Fu delivered a keynote at the SynSci.zh: Di Fu 在格拉斯哥大学举行的 SynSci 2026 卫星会议上作主题演讲，并与研究者探讨社会认知科学与人工智能之间的联系。

Di Fu highlighted university media cover.en: Di Fu highlighted university media coverage of the team’s new face pareidolia research, published in Perception / i-Perception.
Di Fu highlighted university media cover.zh: Di Fu 分享了大学媒体对团队新发表的面孔空想研究的报道。该研究发表于 Perception / i-Perception。

Di Fu shared an invitation to participat.en: Di Fu shared an invitation to take part in MSc student Beyza’s game research experiment, after being its first participant herself. Archived recruitment announcement.
Di Fu shared an invitation to participat.zh: Di Fu 分享了硕士生 Beyza 的游戏研究实验招募信息；她本人曾是首位参与者。此招募公告已存档。

Di Fu shared her Psychology Today articl.en: Di Fu shared her Psychology Today article on humanoid robots, human-robot interaction and their potential role in everyday life.
Di Fu shared her Psychology Today articl.zh: Di Fu 分享了她发表于 Psychology Today 的文章，探讨人形机器人、人机交互及其在日常生活中可能发挥的作用。

Di Fu shared her new role at the Surrey.en: Di Fu shared her new role at the Surrey Institute for People-Centred AI (PAI), alongside her position in the School of Psychology, and reflected on the lab’s growth and the arrival of Misty Robot.
Di Fu shared her new role at the Surrey.zh: Di Fu 分享了她在萨里大学以人为中心人工智能研究院（PAI）的新职务，以及她在心理学学院的职位，并回顾了实验室的发展和 Misty Robot 的到来。

Dr Di Fu co-organised the first HAID wor.en: Dr Di Fu co-organised the first HAID workshop at ACM NordiCHI 2024 in Uppsala, Sweden. It focused on human-centred AI for people living with dementia and their caregivers, including deployment challenges and ethical considerations.
Dr Di Fu co-organised the first HAID wor.zh: Di Fu 博士共同组织了在瑞典乌普萨拉举行的 ACM NordiCHI 2024 首届 HAID workshop。研讨会聚焦于面向痴呆患者及其照护者的以人为中心人工智能，包括部署挑战和伦理考量。

Dr Di Fu co-organised the first InterAI:.en: Dr Di Fu co-organised the first InterAI: Interactive AI for Human-Centred Robotics workshop at IEEE RO-MAN 2024 in Pasadena, USA. It explored interactive AI approaches to human-robot interaction and collaboration.
Dr Di Fu co-organised the first InterAI:.zh: Di Fu 博士共同组织了在美国帕萨迪纳举行的 IEEE RO-MAN 2024 首届 InterAI: Interactive AI for Human-Centred Robotics workshop。研讨会探讨了用于人机交互与协作的交互式人工智能方法。

Dr Di Fu presented Human Impression of H.en: Dr Di Fu presented Human Impression of Humanoid Robots Mirroring Social Cues at ACM/IEEE HRI 2024 in Boulder, Colorado. The study compares how robot platforms and control methods influence perceptions of affective and movement mirroring.
Dr Di Fu presented Human Impression of H.zh: Di Fu 博士在科罗拉多州博尔德举行的 ACM/IEEE HRI 2024 上介绍了 Human Impression of Humanoid Robots Mirroring Social Cues。该研究比较机器人平台和控制方法如何影响人们对情感及动作模仿的感知。

First published online in 2020; assigned.en: First published online in 2020; assigned to the 2021 journal issue.
First published online in 2020; assigned.zh: 2020 年首次在线发表；编入 2021 年期刊卷期。

Public PsyArXiv preprint posted in 2025;.en: Public PsyArXiv preprint posted in 2025; journal review status is based on the October 2026 CV.
Public PsyArXiv preprint posted in 2025;.zh: 2025年发布的公开PsyArXiv预印本；期刊审稿状态依据2026年10月的简历。

Public bioRxiv preprint posted in 2025;.en: Public bioRxiv preprint posted in 2025; journal review status is based on the October 2026 CV.
Public bioRxiv preprint posted in 2025;.zh: 2025年发布的公开bioRxiv预印本；期刊审稿状态依据2026年10月的简历。

Published in 2026; the 2025 preprint is.en: Published in 2026; the 2025 preprint is linked below.
Published in 2026; the 2025 preprint is.zh: 发表于2026年；下方提供2025年预印本链接。

Revise and resubmit, as listed in the Oc.en: Revise and resubmit, as listed in the October 2026 CV. No public preprint link or publication year was established.
Revise and resubmit, as listed in the Oc.zh: 根据2026年10月的简历，该稿件处于修改后重投阶段。未确认公开预印本链接或发表年份。

The University of Hamburg's Knowledge Te.en: The University of Hamburg’s Knowledge Technology group announced that its human-participant study and Wrapyfi framework contribution were accepted at HRI 2024. Co-authored by Dr Di Fu, Wrapyfi connects robots, sensors and applications across multiple middleware frameworks.
The University of Hamburg's Knowledge Te.zh: 汉堡大学知识技术组宣布，其涉及人类参与者的研究及Wrapyfi框架贡献已被HRI 2024接收。Wrapyfi由Di Fu博士合著，可通过多种中间件框架连接机器人、传感器和应用程序。

The lab’s ICRA work on cognitive robotic.en: The Irish Times featured the lab’s ICRA work on cognitive robotic simulation and social attention in an article about the future of AGI and human-AI interaction.
The lab’s ICRA work on cognitive robotic.zh: 《爱尔兰时报》在一篇探讨通用人工智能（AGI）与人机交互未来的文章中，介绍了实验室在ICRA发表的认知机器人仿真与社会注意研究。

Three pillars in a feedback loop.en: Three pillars in a feedback loop
Three pillars in a feedback loop.zh: 反馈循环中的三大支柱

University of Hamburg - Knowledge Techno.zh: 汉堡大学 - 知识技术

Our research connects crossmodal social.en: Our research links crossmodal social cue integration and social cognition mechanisms with human-robot cooperation, human-AI interaction and embodied AI.
Our research connects crossmodal social.zh: 我们的研究将跨模态社会线索整合与社会认知机制，同人机合作、人机交互及具身智能联系起来。

Behavioural and neural evidence constrai.en: Behavioural and neural evidence constrains the architecture and parameters of computational models.
Behavioural and neural evidence constrai.zh: 行为与神经证据约束计算模型的结构与参数。

Models are implemented on robots and con.en: Models are implemented on robots and conversational agents, generating human-like social behaviour under controlled conditions.
Models are implemented on robots and con.zh: 模型部署于机器人与对话智能体，在受控条件下生成类人的社会行为。

Interaction studies test whether model-d.en: Interaction studies test whether model-driven behaviour is perceived as socially meaningful, validating the models and generating new hypotheses about human social cognition.
Interaction studies test whether model-d.zh: 交互研究检验模型驱动的行为能否被人类感知为具有社会意义，从而验证模型，并为人类社会认知研究提出新假设。

A reciprocal, synthetic approach: mechan.en: A reciprocal, synthetic approach: mechanisms of human social cognition are formalised as computational models that generate human-like social behaviour in artificial agents. How people perceive and interact with these agents provides a controlled yet ecologically valid test of both the models and the cognitive theories behind them.
A reciprocal, synthetic approach: mechan.zh: 相互促进的闭环研究路径：我们将人类社会认知的加工机制形式化为计算模型，使人工智能体产生类人的社会行为；人们在交互中如何感知并回应这些智能体，又为模型及其背后的认知理论提供兼具实验控制与生态效度的检验。

HRI-Free evaluates attention models usin.en: HRI-Free evaluates attention models using prerecorded stimuli and human gaze data with physical iCub sensing. This is early-stage evaluation, not live human interaction.
HRI-Free evaluates attention models usin.zh: HRI-Free 使用预录刺激、人类注视数据及实体 iCub 感知评估注意模型。这是早期评估，并非实时人机交互。

Fig. 3 from Abawi and Fu, IEEE ICRA, 202.en: Fig. 3 from Abawi and Fu, IEEE ICRA, 2025.
Fig. 3 from Abawi and Fu, IEEE ICRA, 202.zh: 图 3 引自 Abawi 和 Fu，IEEE ICRA，2025。

Abawi and Fu, IEEE ICRA 2025, Fig. 3.en: Abawi and Fu, IEEE ICRA 2025, Fig. 3

HRI-Free scanpath control pipeline.zh: HRI-Free 扫视路径控制流程

Pipeline diagram: sampled video frames a.en: Pipeline diagram: sampled video frames and audio chunks feed social cue detection; fixation history, output buffers and sequential integration predict a priority map whose peak is converted into coordinates for the robot gaze controller.
Pipeline diagram: sampled video frames a.zh: 流程图：采样的视频帧与音频片段输入社会线索检测；注视历史、输出缓冲与时序整合共同预测优先级图，其峰值经坐标转换后送入机器人注视控制器。

The gaze model pipeline: social cues det.en: The gaze model pipeline: social cues detected in sampled video and audio are integrated over time with fixation history to predict a priority map, whose peak drives the robot's gaze in real time.
The gaze model pipeline: social cues det.zh: 注视模型流程：从采样视频与音频中检测社会线索，结合注视历史进行时序整合以预测优先级图，其峰值实时驱动机器人的注视。

Fig. 2 from Abawi and Fu, IEEE ICRA, 202.en: Fig. 2 from Abawi and Fu, IEEE ICRA, 2025.
Fig. 2 from Abawi and Fu, IEEE ICRA, 202.zh: 图 2 引自 Abawi 和 Fu，IEEE ICRA，2025。

Abawi and Fu, IEEE ICRA 2025, Fig. 2.en: Abawi and Fu, IEEE ICRA 2025, Fig. 2

Neural responses to unfairness to self a.en: Neural responses to unfairness to self and others
Neural responses to unfairness to self a.zh: 自身与他人遭受不公时的神经反应

Fig. 9 from Li, Lai et al. (incl. Fu), N.en: Fig. 9 from Li, Lai et al. (incl. Fu), NeuroImage, 2024; CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
Fig. 9 from Li, Lai et al. (incl. Fu), N.zh: 图 9 引自 Li、Lai 等（含 Fu），NeuroImage，2024；CC BY-NC-ND 4.0。

Original experiment footage: running our.en: Original experiment footage: running our trained audiovisual saliency model, iCub views the same masked-avatar scene as human participants and orients towards gaze and sound cues.
Original experiment footage: running our.zh: 原始实验录像：iCub 搭载我们训练的视听显著性模型，观看与人类被试相同的戴口罩虚拟人场景，并依据注视与声音线索调整视线。

Silent original footage of the iCub robo.en: Silent original footage of the iCub robot head with headphones watching three masked avatars on a monitor and moving its eyes in an audiovisual attention experiment.
Silent original footage of the iCub robo.zh: 无声原始录像：戴着耳机的 iCub 机器人头部注视显示器上三个戴口罩的虚拟人，并在视听注意实验中转动眼球。

An fMRI meta-analysis of social decision.en: An fMRI meta-analysis of social decision-making: unfairness to self and to others both engage the anterior insula and dACC/SMA, more strongly for self. Unfairness to others recruits theory-of-mind regions (IPL-TPJ) during evaluation and cognitive control (left DLPFC) during response.
An fMRI meta-analysis of social decision.zh: 社会决策的 fMRI 元分析：自身与他人遭受不公均激活前脑岛和背侧前扣带回/辅助运动区，且自身不公时更强。他人遭受不公在评价阶段募集心理理论相关脑区（顶下小叶-颞顶联合区），在反应阶段募集认知控制相关脑区（左侧背外侧前额叶）。

Fig. 9 schematic of brain regions in unf.en: Fig. 9 schematic of brain regions in unfairness processing: SMA and dorsal anterior insula are common to self and others, with dACC and ventral anterior insula stronger for self; self-evaluation recruits dACC/SMA, right DLPFC and anterior insula, self-response left anterior insula and putamen; others-evaluation recruits left IPL-TPJ and others-response left DLPFC.
Fig. 9 schematic of brain regions in unf.zh: 论文图 9 不公平加工脑区示意图：辅助运动区和背侧前脑岛为自身与他人共同激活，背侧前扣带回和腹侧前脑岛在自身不公时更强；自身评价募集背侧前扣带回/辅助运动区、右侧背外侧前额叶和前脑岛，自身反应募集左侧前脑岛和壳核；他人评价募集左侧顶下小叶-颞顶联合区，他人反应募集左侧背外侧前额叶。

Social signals rarely arrive through a s.en: Social signals rarely arrive through a single sense. We study when gaze, facial expression, gesture and voice are integrated and when they compete, varying their spatial and semantic congruence in behavioural experiments that inform computational models of multisensory attention.
Social signals rarely arrive through a s.zh: 社会信号很少只经由单一感官传递。我们研究注视、面部表情、手势与语音何时被整合、何时相互竞争，在行为实验中操控其空间与语义一致性，并据此构建多感官注意的计算模型。

Which cognitive and neural mechanisms al.en: Which cognitive and neural mechanisms allow us to detect, attend to and evaluate social information?
Which cognitive and neural mechanisms al.zh: 我们依靠哪些认知与神经机制来觉察、注意并评价社会信息？

We examine how faces, face-like patterns.en: We examine how faces, face-like patterns and gaze capture and orient attention, how cognitive control resolves conflict, and how fairness and empathy shape social evaluation, combining behavioural experiments, EEG and neuroimaging.
We examine how faces, face-like patterns.zh: 我们研究面孔、似脸图案与注视如何捕获并引导注意，认知控制如何化解冲突，以及公平与共情如何塑造社会评价，综合运用行为实验、脑电与神经影像方法。

We build models of attention, scanpaths.en: We build models of attention, scanpaths and crossmodal learning from human data and examine human-centred affective AI, such as pain recognition. Attention models drive robot gaze and are evaluated on humanoid robots and in cognitive robotic simulation.
We build models of attention, scanpaths.zh: 我们基于人类数据构建注意、视觉扫描路径与跨模态学习模型，并探讨以人为中心的情感人工智能，如疼痛识别。注意模型用于驱动机器人注视，并在仿人机器人与认知机器人仿真中接受评估。

How do a robot’s social cues shape coope.en: How do a robot’s social cues shape cooperation, trust and people’s judgements of the robot?
How do a robot’s social cues shape coope.zh: 机器人的社会线索如何影响合作、信任以及人们对机器人的评价？

We manipulate robot gaze, facial express.en: We manipulate robot gaze, facial expression, voice, mirroring and personality in dyadic and multi-party tasks, measuring cooperation, compliance, trust and perceived intelligence. Cognitive robotic simulation lets us evaluate robot behaviour before studies with people.
We manipulate robot gaze, facial express.zh: 我们在双人与多人任务中操控机器人的注视、面部表情、声音、模仿与人格特征，测量合作、服从、信任与感知智能等指标；认知机器人仿真则让我们在开展被试实验之前评估机器人行为。

Beyond robots, we study voice assistants.en: Beyond robots, we study voice assistants, conversational agents and LLM chatbots: how people respond to affective cues, how human strategies and user traits can inform emotion-aware, personalised design, and what AI-mediated social connection means for wellbeing.
Beyond robots, we study voice assistants.zh: 在机器人之外，我们研究语音助手、对话智能体与大语言模型聊天机器人：人们如何回应情感线索，人类应答策略与用户特质如何指导具有情绪感知能力的个性化设计，以及 AI 介导的社会连接对身心福祉意味着什么。

How can models grounded in human cogniti.en: How can models grounded in human cognition give artificial agents human-like perception and social behaviour?
How can models grounded in human cogniti.zh: 如何让基于人类认知的模型赋予人工智能体类人的感知与社会行为？
